definition_quote.value: a frontline public health worker who: (1) Is a trusted member of, or has an unusually close understanding of, the community being served; (2) Serves as a liaison to, link to, or intermediary between health and social services and the community to: (i) Facilitate access to services; and (ii) Improve the quality and cultural competence of service delivery; and (3) Builds individual and community capacity by increasing health knowledge and self–sufficiency through a range of activities
